title: Bench Settlement Schedule for Northbeam Returns and Restocking: Grade Ladder and Refundable Charges
content:
The share of the line price refunded at each inspection grade, and which of the four charges on the original line come back with it, are published against each Northbeam Returns and Restocking schedule as follows.

## The grade ladder

The grade refund ladder is the share of the line price refunded at each inspection grade. Each schedule publishes a percentage for all seven grades.

| Inspection grade | Standard Fifteen Day | Member Extended Thirty Day | Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour | Activated Wireless Device | Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | Business Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| as new and sealed | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 0 | 100 |
| open box, everything in the box | 100 | 100 | 95 | 90 | 0 | 100 |
| open box, something missing | 85 | 90 | 80 | 75 | 0 | 88 |
| damaged by the customer | 60 | 70 | 50 | 45 | 0 | 55 |
| defective on arrival | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| not as described | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| beyond economic repair | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

All figures are percentages of the line price.

## The four charges on the original line

Tax refunded means whether sales tax on the line is refunded with it. Delivery charge refunded means whether the delivery charge on the line is refunded. Installation charge refunded means whether an installation charge on the line is refunded. Recycling fee refunded means whether a recycling or disposal fee on the line is refunded.

| Return schedule | Sales tax | Delivery charge | Installation charge | Recycling fee |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | refunded | not refunded | not refunded | not refunded |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | refunded | refunded | not refunded | not refunded |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | refunded | not refunded | not refunded | refunded |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | refunded | not refunded | not refunded | not refunded |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | refunded | not refunded | not refunded | not refunded |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | refunded | not refunded | not refunded | refunded |

## Points of judgement on the schedule

Every schedule refunds sales tax and no schedule refunds an installation charge. The two grades that name the retailer's own failure, defective on arrival and not as described, stand at the whole of the line price on every schedule including Open Box and Clearance Final Sale, which publishes nothing at all for the four grades that do not. Beyond economic repair stands at nothing on all six schedules. Only Member Extended Thirty Day Return returns the delivery charge; only the two crew schedules return a recycling fee.
